title: John Lynch on Brandon Aiyuk: We'll look for a path that works for both sides

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Lynch on Brandon Aiyuk: We'll look for a path that works for both sides
sources.description: Brandon Aiyuk filed for reinstatement from the 49ers' left squad list this week and he's expected to be at the team's facility on Friday to take the next step in resuming his football career.
